import sys

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = list(map(int, input().split()))
    
    n = data[0]
    a = data[1:n+1]
    
    a.sort()
    if n % 2 == 1:
        idx = n // 2
    else:
        idx = n // 2 - 1
    print(a[idx])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
